newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Small bomb explodes near Budapest synagogue.
newsitem.headline: Small bomb explodes near Budapest synagogue.

text.p: A homemade bomb exploded near Europe's largest synagogue in the Hungarian capital Budapest but caused no injuries, police said on Thursday.
The bomb exploded at about 8 p.m. on Wednesday in a dustbin in front of a house about 200 metres (yards) from the Dohanyi Utca synagogue and scattered debris up to 20 metres (yards).
Police said there was no indication that the blast had been intended to damage the synagogue, which was recently reopened after a complete refurbishment.
